title: Scheduled Regression and Synthetic Monitoring
description: Run approved browser journeys on a schedule, retain comparable history, and notify only on actionable changes.
setup_prompt: Use Scheduled Regression and Synthetic Monitoring with my proven browser QA route. Configure the approved cadence, groups, retention, safe unattended behavior, trend reporting, and notifications, then perform one controlled trigger test.

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks schedules
recommended_tools.purpose: Create, inspect, trigger, update, pause, and audit saved workflow schedules

recommended_tools.name: Notification MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Deliver explicitly configured actionable alerts to the customer's chosen destination

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create or update authorized recurring-failure records

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Run completeness, alert correctness, and diagnostic retention
Noise, missed detection, and recovery behavior
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Schedule, concurrency, environment, and synthetic identity design
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Monitoring coverage of important customer journeys
Detection delay, operating cost, and alert usefulness
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Saved schedule bound to an exact route and groups
